draft-edge.description: Draft Edge is an individual design challenge that tests a participant’s ability to transform ideas into visually compelling designs. Through two creative rounds, participants demonstrate design thinking, creativity, and the ability to work within constraints while producing clean and impactful visuals.

rounds.description: Participants will be given a poorly designed visual such as a poster, banner, logo, or thumbnail. Their task is to analyze the flaws and redesign it into a visually appealing and well-structured design using Canva or similar tools.
Participants must create a minimal yet creative design based on a theme revealed on the spot. The design must follow specific constraints that test creativity, simplicity, and design discipline.

rules_and_regulations.tools: Participants must use Canva or similar design tools
rules_and_regulations.submission: Designs must be submitted within the given time
rules_and_regulations.fair_play: Any rule violation or late submission will lead to disqualification

judging_criteria.description: Innovative ideas and unique visual approach
Proper understanding and execution of the given challenge
Layout balance, color usage, and overall appeal
Smart and effective use of design tools and elements
